workflow_runs.display_title: fix: resolve all 179 compilation errors across 10+ Dart files

head_commit.message:
fix: resolve all 179 compilation errors across 10+ Dart files

- ai_engine.dart: fix static generic factory methods (ok/err), dynamic cast in loops
- ai_assistant_widget.dart: fix import path, bracket balance
- ai_page_v2.dart: add missing shell_nav import, permissions toList()
- supplier_integration.dart: add ApiList helper, fix all dynamic->String casts
- whatsapp_service.dart: fix all dynamic casts, Map spreads, template variable ordering
- whatsapp_center_page.dart: add models import, fix WhatsAppConversation duplicate, fix _ConversationTile build syntax (collection-if)
- whatsapp_chat_page.dart: fix ambiguous WhatsAppMessageType import, dynamic casts, duplicate dispose
- whatsapp_models.dart: fix DateTime.parse null safety, enum fromJson
- reference_page.dart: fix _StatusChip arg, _detailRow args, _filterDropdown _Facet replacement
- reorder_page.dart: fix TableColumnWidths.column params (numeric/alignment not supported)
- supplier_connectivity_page.dart: fix bracket balance in _SupplierCard and dialogs
- customers_page_v2.dart: add intl import, fix CustomerFormV2->CustomerForm, dynamic casts
- organisms.dart: fix DateTime.parse null safety
- glass_card.dart: add margin parameter

Build now passes: flutter build web --release

workflow_runs.display_title: feat: Phase 11 - Super Admin CRM backend APIs

head_commit.message:
feat: Phase 11 - Super Admin CRM backend APIs

- Added Super Admin CRM API endpoints:
  - GET/POST /superadmin/stats (dashboard KPIs)
  - GET/POST /superadmin/pharmacies
  - GET/POST /superadmin/prospects
  - GET/POST /superadmin/invoices
  - GET/POST /superadmin/tickets
  - GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /superadmin/roles
  - PUT /superadmin/roles/:id/permissions (permissions matrix)
- Created prospects and tickets tables with RLS policies
- All endpoints protected by requireSuperAdmin guard
- Role permissions matrix with module/action granularity
